body: To the editor: Please keep the seasonal farmers market in the budget. Many of us on Juniper Street use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Juniper Street for 22 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made.

Jolene Gilroy, Kettle Hill
